article.title: Mamdani launches NYC Mayor’s Office of Worker Power
article.author: teleSUR Desk
article.content: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has launched the Mayor’s Office of Worker Power to help workers organize, understand their rights and connect with unions and worker centers. The office will focus particularly on immigrants and undocumented workers vulnerable to workplace abuses. The post Mamdani launches NYC Mayor’s Office of Worker Power appeared first on MR Online .
